title: Spiced Kooky Lassi Parfait
description: A refreshing yogurt parfait infused with the warmth of Indian spices and the sweetness of malty notes.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the kooky and malty.
Add the Indian spices and stir until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the yogurt and lassi.
Layer the kooky-malty mixture and the yogurt-lassi mixture in a glass or parfait dish.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of yogurt-lassi mixture on top.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving.
